description: Circular torus, poloidal winding. R=0.15m, r=0.02m, N=100, I=1A. Each turn is a small loop around the tube cross-section. Turns distributed evenly around the centreline by toroidal angle.

geometry_interpretation.centreline: circle of radius majorRadius=0.15m in XY plane, axis=Z
geometry_interpretation.turn_k_loop_normal: (sin phi_k, -cos phi_k, 0)  — computed from area vector via right-hand rule. For parametrisation p_k(psi)=(R+r cos psi) r_hat_k + r sin psi z_hat, the area vector is in the -phi_hat_k direction: n_hat_k = (sin phi_k, -cos phi_k, 0).
geometry_interpretation.turn_k_points: p(psi) = (R + r cos(psi))(cos phi_k, sin phi_k, 0) + r sin(psi) * Z_hat

winding_mode_interpretation.description: Each turn k is a closed loop of circumference 2*pi*r wound around the tube cross-section. The N turns are distributed evenly around the major circle by toroidal angle phi_k = 2*pi*k/N.
winding_mode_interpretation.per_turn_wire_length_note: Approximation: ignores toroidal helix pitch. Error < 0.3% for N>=20.

discretisation_interpretation.path_k_description: Circle of radius r=0.02m in the plane containing Z-axis and radial direction r_hat_k=(cos phi_k, sin phi_k, 0). Centre at (R cos phi_k, R sin phi_k, 0).
discretisation_interpretation.path_k_parametric: p_k(psi) = (R + r cos psi) * r_hat_k  +  r sin(psi) * z_hat,  psi in [0, 2pi)

checks.note: Loop normal from right-hand rule applied to p_0(psi)=(R+r cos psi, 0, r sin psi). Area vector integral = (0, -pi*r^2, 0), so n_hat_0 = (0, -1, 0) = -phi_hat_0. N.B. the outward radial r_hat_0=(1,0,0) is NOT the loop normal.
Ampere: B = mu0*N*I/(2*pi*R) = 4pi*1e-7*100*1/(2*pi*0.15) = 1.3333e-4 T. 2% tolerance for N=100 discretisation.
Outside torus (r > R+r_tube): B must be near zero by Ampere's law.
